items.name: about-page
items.title: About page
items.description: About the company: the head, the story in one narrow column, the numbers in the double rule, what the team holds to (feature grid) and the closing band, in the site's frame.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Rows that open in place, in Conare's style: hairlines between them, a 12px chevron that turns as one opens, the answer opening over 260ms and closing in 180ms with its words settling down a beat after. One open at a time unless multiple.

items.name: account-menu
items.title: Account menu
items.description: The sidebar's foot: a black square and the email; it opens upward with the credits left, sign-in and security, and Sign out in red.

items.name: accuracy-page
items.title: Accuracy page
items.description: Accuracy as it ships: Performance's second view, its bar with the two views and the test's actions (Add questions opening in place, Copy link, Run again as the one dark button), then the Test at work view.

items.name: accuracy-views
items.title: Accuracy views
items.description: A team's own questions and whether search reached the right page, four ways: Test at work (tiles, the list and a window of a hundred squares; it ships), Verdict first, Two searches and Question sheet. Each question opens to what came back.

items.name: add-data
items.title: Add data
items.description: The ways data comes in, the fewest clicks first: a corpus sent by API with one prompt, an app connected with one click, or files that upload as they land. Nothing to name first.

items.name: add-documents
items.title: Add documents
items.description: Write first documents from the console: upload files or paste text. A PDF, Word, PowerPoint or Excel file becomes one document whose hits cite their page, slide or sheet.

items.name: agent-prompt
items.title: Agent prompt
items.description: Connect a coding agent over MCP: the agent at work on top, the prompt in a box that opens, then Copy prompt with the one-click installs and the API call beside it. The agent signs in with OAuth, so no key is shown.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A question that must be answered first, on Dialog's window: the title, one line saying what happens, Cancel and the danger action. Focus starts on Cancel; the scrim does nothing; Escape cancels.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A red box for what broke: one box per problem, set apart, with the problem in words and the button that fixes it.

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: One line above the header for news: the whole ribbon is the link, on the red wash, with a black capitals tag that turns red on hover and the call to action underlined in the same sentence.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: A plain box that keeps its shape as it grows, so a picture or a window never reflows: the blog card's 5:4 picture, the hero's 2:1 frame.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Who or what something belongs to, always square: the workspace switcher's 20px hairline tile with an initial, and the account's black square that stands in for a profile picture. A picture crops square and falls back to the initial.

items.name: bento
items.title: Bento
items.description: What a product does as cells of different sizes in the double rule: large, wide, tall or plain, each led by a red pixel pattern.

items.name: blog-card
items.title: Blog card
items.description: A post as a card: in its own ruled box that takes the paper under the pointer, a picture of cells on the grained dark panel with the category in red, then the title, its line, and who it is from and the date in ruled tags. A window can play in the picture once the card is on screen.

items.name: blog-page
items.title: Blog page
items.description: The blog: the head, the categories with a search beside them, the posts three across as blog cards, every card in a row one height, and the closing band. Nothing matching says so.

items.name: blog-post-page
items.title: Blog post page
items.description: A blog post: the trail and the title centred, a wide dark panel as the picture, who it is from and when, the text in one narrow column, a link on, then more posts from the category.

items.name: burst
items.title: Burst
items.description: The hero frame's infinite cells on red: level rectangles near the frame's edge, each redrawn as it recedes to the center, the copies' edges making the hatch. Corners adds a halftone square to each face, kept clear of the hero's window.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Buttons that belong together sharing a hairline: secondary buttons in a row, or the dark split button with its menu arrow.

items.name: button-link
items.title: Button link
items.description: The website's button: a square link, 36px with a 13px label (28px and 12px small), whose hover is a fill of 6px squares coming in from the left; dark with the pixel arrow for the main call to action, outlined for the rest, red, and light and ghost on dark bands.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Every action in the console: secondary by default; dark for the one main action, the website's pixel button with red squares running in on hover; ghost for tools in rows; danger for what removes something, held to confirm; brand for the fix to a failure; and a square icon button.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month to pick a day from: square 32px day cells, the picked day in ink, Menu's red square marking today, 12px muted weekday heads and ghost arrow buttons. Arrows, Home, End and Page Up or Down move; Enter picks.

items.name: call-to-action
items.title: Call to action
items.description: The band before the footer: the closing line and one action on the red, over a jumbled sheet of cells whose grid keeps redrawing itself, in a triple rule.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A bordered box for one subject: a head with its title and actions over a hairline, then the body. Square, no shadow. Framed adds the website's double rule; a door is a whole card that opens something.

items.name: careers-page
items.title: Careers page
items.description: The open roles, a row each in the double rule (the name, the team and the place, the whole row a link), or a line when there are none, in the site's frame.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides in a row, one or more in view: square, a hairline round the track and between slides, the arrows as ghost icon buttons with the place in tabular figures between them. Native scroll snap, so a swipe or a trackpad moves it as the arrows do. Never plays on its own.

items.name: cell-burst
items.title: Cell burst
items.description: Seeded square cells bursting from a point: a sheet of cells with some redrawn smaller and smaller down to a vanishing point, each a wedge of hairlines. Jumble scatters it, ledger makes it a spreadsheet's, strong holds up on the red, trace sets the grid redrawing itself. Grain is the texture it sits under.

items.name: changelog-page
items.title: Changelog page
items.description: What changed, newest first: the head, then each release under a hairline, its date and version on the left, held in view as its notes pass, the title and the notes beside it, and the closing band.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: How Conare draws a number: bars per day under a meter's total and the week's change, lines for series over time, bars for shares of a total, and one split bar for a whole in parts. A 1px grid, axes from 0, and pointing reads a value.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A yes or no inside a form: a 16px square in the hairline that fills ink with a drawn check when on, a bar when partly on.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code to read and copy, in one dark window on the site and in the product: a pill for each request or language and Copy on one row, a rule, then the code. There is always at least one pill.

items.name: code-pop
items.title: Code pop
items.description: Code that opens from a "Show code" button: the request behind a result. It opens in place: the code takes its own line under the row, in the dark code window, and pushes what follows.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A part that opens in place and pushes what follows: the row grows to its content over 260ms and closes in 180ms, the content fading up from a slight blur, the chevron turning. From the keyboard it opens at once.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: One box for everything, opened by ⌘K, / or the sidebar's search: documents as you type, namespaces, pages and actions. It opens and closes without animation; the input keeps focus and the arrows move the highlighted row.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison table
items.description: What each plan includes, side by side: a row per thing, a column per plan, the red square for included and a hairline for not, in the double rule.

items.name: contact-page
items.title: Contact page
items.description: Contact: the head, the ways to reach the team on the left, the form on the right in the double rule with its one dark button. It calls nothing: it emits submit, and shows what happens next once the app says it is sent.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: Menu's square panel and rows opened where the pointer right-clicks, or under the focused row with Shift+F10 or the menu key. Arrows, Home, End and Escape are handled; focus returns to what was clicked.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: The copy button beside a value: the label swaps from Copy to Copied in place, the width of the longer word, so nothing moves, and the check draws its stroke.

items.name: copy-text
items.title: Copy text
items.description: An identifier or an endpoint as typed, in mono, with a quiet button that copies it and shows a check.

items.name: count
items.title: Count
items.description: The one counter: a number that counts to its new value when it changes, so a syncing source's documents visibly climb. Reduced motion shows the new value at once.

items.name: credit-history
items.title: Credit history
items.description: Every time credits were added, newest first. A team can add credits for years, so it never opens all at once: the latest five, then five more at a time, each line landing on the rule.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A table people narrow and order: filter chips over it (Label, or Label: pick, the menu's check on the choice), heads that sort, and five rows at a time with Show N more under them, each new row landing on the one above.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A date in a field: the 32px text field that opens a Calendar in Menu's square panel under it, flipping above when there is no room. Picking closes it and returns focus to the field; Escape closes it unchanged.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A native dialog: the title, a close button, the form. Focus stays inside; Escape and the scrim close it. Square, a hairline, no shadow; it rises 8px as it opens.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets the reading direction for what is inside it, left to right or right to left, and gives it to components through useDirection(). Logical utilities follow it; code stays left to right, as the code windows do.

items.name: docs-blocks
items.title: Docs blocks
items.description: A docs page's body block by block: paragraphs, headings, lists led by a red square, callouts (a warning on the wash), ruled tables under a paper head, the code window, an endpoint's fields with nested ones behind a toggle, and link cards in the double rule whose pixel pattern turns red.

items.name: document-download
items.title: Document download
items.description: A document downloads when it is pressed, and what was pressed says so: the row's mark or the button turns to a check for a moment, since the browser's own bar can sit out of sight.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge over the page dimmed to 16%: the console's sidebar on a phone (left, 300px at most), or a choice from the bottom edge. In over 240ms on the strong ease-out, out in 180ms; Escape closes it at once.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: A dashed box for a list with nothing in it yet: one line on what is missing and the actions that fill it.

items.name: eval-card
items.title: Eval card
items.description: A benchmark as a card: its name, our score and rank, the top five as bars with ours in red (kept in when it ranks lower), and the way to its page. The paper comes in under the pointer.

items.name: eval-viz
items.title: Eval window
items.description: One benchmark as a window: what it measures, the model's score and rank, then the leaderboard's rows entering in turn and their bars growing, the model's own row in red, and the benchmark's disclosure under them. VizWindow is the frame every product window shares.

items.name: facts
items.title: Facts
items.description: Short facts about one thing, each a small hairline box with its name and value, so a row of them wraps cleanly.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Questions in the website's double-rule frame, one open at a time. Wide, the list and the answer beside it, the open question's ground gliding to the next and the pointer's lighter ground following it; on phones each answer opens under its question as a red plus turns to a minus.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature grid
items.description: What a product does, a card per feature in the website's double rule: a red pixel pattern, the name in Faculty Glyphic and its line. One across on phones, two from 640px, three from 1024px.

items.name: features-page
items.title: Features page
items.description: A product's page: the head with the one dark call to action, what it does (feature grid), what it connects to (logo strip), one customer's words and the closing band, in the site's frame.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Text input: 32px, a hairline that goes ink on focus, an optional leading icon at the 28px filter size, and a red border with its message when invalid. Field puts the label over it and the hint or error under it.

items.name: filter-chip
items.title: Filter chip
items.description: One filter as a menu button under the search box: its name, or the name and the pick once chosen, opening a radio list with Any first.

items.name: filter-menu
items.title: Filter menu
items.description: Every filter in one menu from the search box's bar: app, type and date as radio groups, the button counting what is on. A second press clears a pick; the menu stays open for the next.

items.name: fix-button
items.title: Fix button
items.description: The fix for a failure: the website's dark button that signs in, counts the changes as they come back and ends on a check, all in one cell.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Fields stacked with their labels, errors shown once a field is left or the form is sent, a failure from the server above the actions, and the main action last.

items.name: glide-mark
items.title: Gliding block
items.description: One block for a whole list: it glides to the row under the pointer in 200ms and rests on the picked one when the pointer leaves, so moving down a list is one movement.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: The home's first band: the eyebrow tag, the headline in Faculty Glyphic with its red stop and letter reveal, one line and one action settling up in turn, then the red frame (the room grid, the burst and the grain in a triple rule) with the window in front and the teams as stepped tabs on its top, taking turns on a timer.

items.name: highlight-text
items.title: Highlight text
items.description: The headline reveal: each letter starts faint and red, fades up, then settles to ink, spreading from the centre or the start; trailing characters stay red.

items.name: home-numbers
items.title: Home numbers
items.description: The key numbers on Explorer's first screen, each leading to its page: documents, queries this month, the typical search. Three takes: a strip along the foot, the double rule with this month's bars, or a line under the box with the documents in the title.

items.name: home-page
items.title: Home page
items.description: The website's home: the hero with the one dark call to action and the window in the red frame, who connects (logo strip), what it does (feature grid), one customer's words, the questions and the closing red band, in the site's frame.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A preview of what a link points to, in Menu's square panel: it opens after the pointer rests 300ms (at once on keyboard focus), lets the pointer cross into it, and closes when the pointer leaves both.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code in square 32px cells, Geist Mono digits, the cell being typed into edged in ink.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: One row of a card's list: 12px, its title on the left and what it is on the right, a hairline between rows. A row that opens something is one link that fills to the card's edges with the paper under the pointer, its chevron darkening; a row can carry a tool at its end.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key or a shortcut: 11px in the face around it, plain or in a hairline box, hidden on touch screens.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Field's label on its own: 12px in the soft grey, with an optional muted note such as optional.

items.name: legal-page
items.title: Legal page
items.description: A page of policy text: on the left in the double rule, the page's sections, held in view, the one being read on the paper with the red square; beside it the tag, the title, when it was last updated and the text.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Text that goes somewhere: ink with a quiet underline 4px under it that turns ink on hover, and the quiet link under a list that shows more of it.

items.name: list-detail-page
items.title: List and detail page
items.description: A list and the page of one thing in it: the list with a filter and the one dark button, each row opening its thing; the thing's page with its name in mono, a way back, its facts and what it holds in a flush card.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: The website's dot matrix: a 3 by 3 of 2px squares that blink in a sweep while something works, beside the word for what is working.

items.name: login-page
items.title: Login page
items.description: The sign-in page as it ships: the mark over one line while the app forwards to sign-in, or, when sign-in comes back with an error, the reason and the ways on (book a demo, request access, sign in again).

items.name: logo-strip
items.title: Logo strip
items.description: Who uses it or what it connects to: the band's head, then a 64px cell per name in the website's double rule, two, three and six across. Names are wordmarks set as text in the type's colour.

items.name: marked-text
items.title: Marked text
items.description: A passage with the query's words in medium weight and ink, so the reader sees why it matched.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A button that opens a short list of choices or actions: a square panel in a hairline, rows with a red square marker, counts and a check. Arrows, Home, End, Escape and Tab are handled.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Menu triggers in a row on the paper, each opening Menu's square panel of rows. Left and Right move along the row and carry an open menu with them; pointing at another trigger while one is open switches at once.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: Progress as a 4px bar with an ink fill (the largest share red), or as one 6px square per step: done in ink, the next in red, the rest an empty hairline. It covers shadcn's progress.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native select
items.description: The browser's own select drawn as the console's field: square, the hairline that darkens on hover and turns to a 2px ink edge on focus, and its own 12px chevron.

items.name: newsletter
items.title: Newsletter
items.description: A sign-up for news by email: the band's head, one email field and the one dark button in the double rule; the app sends it and says what follows.

items.name: not-found-page
items.title: Not found page
items.description: The page for an address that leads nowhere: the code in the tag, one line on what happened, the one dark way home, then where people usually meant to go, in the site's frame.

items.name: overview-band
items.title: Overview band
items.description: What Conare is doing for a team, in one band above the numbers: the pipeline's four steps with its numbers, three questions a buyer asks answered in a sentence each, or the dark live panel with the last searches landing.

items.name: overview-page
items.title: Overview page
items.description: Overview as it ships, a page composition: the setup line, the greeting and how many documents agents search beside the API key's window in the double rule, Queries beside Credits, the largest namespaces. The console's frame and page head come with it.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pages of a long list: two secondary icon buttons around the page count in tabular figures. Show more is the quiet line under a list that opens a few more at a time, the console's usual way.

items.name: parse-page
items.title: Parse page
items.description: Parse as a page: files to try and your own (pressed or dropped), the reading beside the page, then what comes next: add it to a namespace, copy the Markdown, or open the API call in place.

items.name: parse-views
items.title: Parse views
items.description: A document as Conare read it, three ways: Page beside text (the page and the dark window of what was read, joined by pointing; it ships), Regions (every region numbered with its OCR confidence) and Plain or Conare (a plain reader's text and Conare's, one handle between).

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Menu's square panel for any content: a few settings, a short form, a note. It grows 4px from its trigger over 200ms and leaves in 120ms, flips to the side with room and stays inside the viewport. Focus moves in; Escape, a press outside or tabbing away closes it.

items.name: price-viz
items.title: Price window
items.description: Accuracy against price as a window: each provider a square point on a log price axis, the model's own in red with the corner nothing beats; pointing at a point or its row scopes it with a crosshair, brackets, axis readouts and its exact figures.

items.name: pricing-page
items.title: Pricing page
items.description: Pricing: the head with the one dark call to action, each group of prices (pricing table), Enterprise as the page's one red block with what its terms cover, the questions and the closing band.

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: Pricing table
items.description: One group of prices: its case on the left, its cards on the right in the double rule. Each card's price large in tabular figures with its unit, one line, and what it includes led by the red square.

items.name: product-menu
items.title: Product menu
items.description: The header's Product dropdown: the products with their one line, a rule, then benchmarks and pricing, beside a window that shows the one pointed at. One highlight glides between items. It is the navigation menu.

items.name: product-viz
items.title: Product window
items.description: A product as a small window: search's question and best passage, a source syncing, a file parsed to Markdown, an embedding's values as bars, results reranked into a new order.

items.name: prompt-bar
items.title: Prompt bar
items.description: A floating dark glass bar that asks the website: it types its phrases, raises its templates when focused, answers the questions it has answers for in a thread that grows upward, and comes into view once the page scrolls, or from the start when docked.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One of a few, all in view: square 16px boxes with an ink square in the picked one, rows 28px with a label and an optional hint.

items.name: request-access-page
items.title: Request access page
items.description: The request-access page as it ships: the mark, the title and one line, then the part for where the person is: sign in first, try again, the form (work email, name, company, team size, what they want to build) or what happens next.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Two panes and the hairline between them, as the docs panel sits beside the page. The hairline turns ink under the pointer, while dragged and when focused; drag it or use the arrow keys.

items.name: roll-text
items.title: Roll text
items.description: A label that rolls up to a copy of itself on hover or focus: the console's pace for its lists, the website's for its footer.

items.name: room-grid
items.title: Room grid
items.description: The hero frame as a room in one-point perspective: orthogonals to the back wall and rings closing up as they recede. A tile lights under the pointer, and a few light on their own, trading places while the frame is on screen.

items.name: scope-menu
items.title: Scope menu
items.description: Where a search looks: every namespace or one, each with its app's mark and size, a filter once the list is long, arrows and Escape. Its parts are the combobox (a list with a filter) and the select (a listbox on Menu's panel with a check on the pick).

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A region that scrolls on its own with the console's thin scrollbars: the thumb in neutral-600 on a clear track, neutral-400 on the dark window. Native scrolling, so wheel, touch and keyboard all work.

items.name: search-box
items.title: Search box
items.description: The search box and the library's input group: the question, attached files, the plus for more data, the scope, the Enter cue and the red arrow.

items.name: search-results
items.title: Search results
items.description: Best match in its card with the written answer or the passage, the pages around it and its source; then the other matches as quiet lines, each opening in place to its passage. The query's words are in medium weight, and each opened result can download its document.

items.name: search-run
items.title: Search run
items.description: A search on the request's clock: Searching shimmers over the namespaces it reads while cells of the index flicker; then Found in, the namespaces with results keep a red square, each document found is a red square that names itself, and the footer gives the count, when it finished, the API's time and Show code.

items.name: searches-page
items.title: Searches page
items.description: Searches as it ships, a page composition: every search an agent ran, newest first, with the page's one filter in its head. A row opens in place to what the agent read, its documents to download, and why a search went wrong with what to do about it.

items.name: section-head
items.title: Section head
items.description: How the website heads a page or a band: the red tag in the site's capitals, the line in Faculty Glyphic on 1.15 lines, one muted line and the one action under it. Centred, or started at the left beside its content.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: The hairline as its own part: 1px in the edge colour, across or down. Inset is the menu's, running out to the panel's edges with 4px of air above and below.

items.name: settings-page
items.title: Settings page
items.description: Settings as the console draws it: one title and its parts as line tabs, switching in place, each part the settings table. General: the company's name to edit in place, its ID and when it joined, then Sign out. Members: who is in, with Invite members. Sign-in: each way in with its switch.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel at the right edge over a dimmed page, the console's docs panel: 420px, a hairline edge, the 48px bar with the title and a close button. It slides 16px in over 220ms and leaves in 160ms; Escape closes it at once and focus returns.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer text
items.description: Words that say something is working: a lighter band runs across them for as long as the work does. Reduced motion shows them still.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The console's navigation: a label over each group, a row with its icon and count, a red edge on the page you are on, and a count that turns red when something failed.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site footer
items.description: The website's foot on the dark gray under the grain: the mark and the line with the legal row under them, the link columns (each label rolling up to a copy of itself under the pointer), and the wordmark cut off by the page edge. Pinned, it waits under the page and is uncovered as the page scrolls off it.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site header
items.description: The website header: the logo, the Product menu and the links on the page's true center with a paper block gliding under them, the two buttons at the edge; below 768px a square button folds the links into a sheet.

items.name: site-page
items.title: Site page
items.description: Every website page's frame: the announcement bar if there is one, the header, the page in main on its own ground, and the footer pinned under it, uncovered as the page scrolls off it.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading that is never empty: a held part is the real part drawn from a blank record, its layout and rules kept and its content hidden, so nothing moves when the answer lands. The rules come in after 300ms, so a fast answer never shows them.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value on a range: the meter's 4px track with ink up to the value and a square 12px ink thumb.

items.name: source-row
items.title: Source row
items.description: A source as getting started lists it: its app's mark and name, linking to the source, then its sync's state as a tag, and with detail its last and next sync.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A label over a number in a row of stats, split by hairlines. A stat that drives a chart is a button: it fills with the paper under the pointer, and the pinned one stays filled with a red edge on top.

items.name: step-viz
items.title: Step window
items.description: How it works' window: one search shown step by step as an agent window, from the ask to what changed, with a shimmering status, records as chips, the dot matrix and a ticking timer; picking a step crossfades what is in it.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Steps that open one at a time: the one to do is the only open thing, a finished step folds to a line that says what came of it, and a step not reached is dimmed and locked.

items.name: subprocessor-table
items.title: Subprocessor table
items.description: The subprocessors as a policy page's ruled table in the double rule: who, what for, what data and where, each name linking to its data-processing terms in the red.

items.name: suggestion-chips
items.title: Suggestion chips
items.description: Questions to start from under the search box, each ending on the namespace that answers it; a block glides to the one pointed at.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On or off with no words: a square thumb in a square track. The row beside it says what the state means. Black when on, grey while it can't be changed.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of one kind of thing: a paper head in sentence case, 40px rows, numbers in tabular figures, IDs in mono, and a status column of tags. Settings and the audit log share one plainer table with buttons one width.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A few views of one thing: line tabs for a page's sections (an ink underline and a red square on the current one) and the segmented control for a chart's view or range, its white block gliding to the pick.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A short label for a state or a kind. In the console: ready in a hairline, syncing in black with the dot matrix, failed in the red wash with its square, quiet notes in grey. On the website: 10px capitals on the red.

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: One customer's words in the website's double rule: the tag, the quote in Faculty Glyphic, centred and balanced, then who said it: the company's square initial, the role and the company.

items.name: text-swap
items.title: Text swap
items.description: Two labels in one cell, so nothing around them moves: the first leaves up, the next arrives from below with a touch of blur, and a check draws its stroke.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Several lines of text: 13px on 20px lines, the hairline that darkens on hover and turns to a 2px ink edge on focus, red when invalid.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A short note at the bottom right saying what just happened: black, for four seconds, three at most. Pointing at one holds them, and a hidden tab stops their time.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: Options that stay pressed on the segmented control's track, several at once or one that can be let go.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A pressable chip that stays on: a red square at its start and an ink edge while it is on.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: An icon button's name in the inverse fill, 11px, under its trigger: 300ms wait under the pointer, at once on keyboard focus, 125ms in. Right after another tooltip it shows at once.

items.name: top-bar
items.title: Top bar
items.description: The 48px bar over every console page: breadcrumbs, each step back a link, the page itself in ink, a namespace in mono. Its crumbs are the breadcrumb.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: The console's type as one reference: a 20px Faculty Glyphic page title, Geist at 13px for everything else, 12px meta, 11px captions, Geist Mono for keys and IDs, a link with a quiet underline and a query's words in medium weight.

items.name: work-panel
items.title: Card and dark panel
items.description: A card beside the dark panel in the website's double rule: the title with its red full stop, one line and the one action; on the panel the grain, a sheet of cells and one small window that plays once.

items.name: workspace-switcher
items.title: Workspace switcher
items.description: The sidebar head's organization switcher: the brand mark, the organization over its customer and role, and a menu of every organization grouped by customer, the current one checked, then New organization, settings and members.

items.name: written-answer
items.title: Written answer
items.description: The written answer above the passages, on the paper with a red edge: the words at 16px citing their sources as small ink squares. Answer first shows it by itself; on request is one button, since it costs a second query; beside the page sets the cited page next to the words.
